events.title: STEM: Mathema Adventures: A D&D-Inspired Math Game Program for Kids

cases.refreshed: Join us for a Dungeons & Dragons session that will be built around the magical world of Mathema, where math problems are as numerous as the creatures you will encounter in this interactive and immersive adventure that will help young patrons practice math. Each session will cover different grade-level math concepts. And math problems will be customized according to the grade level(s) of participants. Recommended for kids in kindergarten through 5th grade. So, if you are just learning these concepts, need a review, or just enjoy playing Dungeons and Dragons, we look forward to seeing you there. No registration required; first-come, first-served; capacity is limited. At 3:30 p.m. we will distribute five tickets; only participating children need a ticket.

cases.refreshed: Looking for cute, fun, creative, and crafty wares? Check out the ARTrepreneur: Teen Craft Fair. All teens featured at this fair have completed the ARTrepreneur entrepreneur program and are small business owners. Come support them and check out their incredible products. Cash and most payment apps accepted. No obligation to purchase. The Fair will be held during the TeenHQ Theater Production. Fuzzy and Fluffy is among the scheduled vendors and will sell popular crocheted items, including loaf cats, octopi, and chickens. Its keychains include mini octopuses, mushroom pops, and mini chickens. These items are perfect as birthday or holiday gifts, or even room decor! We're looking forward to meeting you at our market! Welcome to Green Apple Boutique! We are a small business located in the Bay Area and would love to have you as a part of our community! Our shop is currently focusing on the production of pins and jewelry but we plan to expand our inventory to cute stationery in the future! Lils Creations features handmade jewelry, customized stationery, beadable pens, unique keychains and charms. Designed with care, high-quality materials, and a touch of character-inspired charm, my items are crafted to offer thoughtful, one-of-a-kind gifts and accessories. Calderon & Co's business is the amalgamation of a love for toys, 3D printing, and making money. The goal was to create a toy that could satisfy the urge to fidget or imagine new, forbearing the spontaneous horrors of a bored mind, without being a traditional, hyper-consumeristic toy that serves little purpose beyond draining your wallet. Three main problems were identified, alongside a single solution: affordable toys suck, they don't keep people still, and the CEO of C&C is very broke. The solution? A selection of 3D-printed fidget toys, tested profusely. What makes this selection unique is that people of all ages can come to the table and try the fidgets firsthand. Every effort is made to ensure product quality through careful selection of what gets sold, and by personally breaking them in so the initial rough texture is ameliorated as much as possible. Aydraw Art's crafts and creations take the ease- and add some style. We create practical trinkets such as beautiful handmade keychains, pipe cleaner flowers, cards, cups, jewelry bowls, and so much more all to inspire your creative flame! For reasonable prices add some bling and express your individuality and creativity today! Two Tiny Potatoes sells yarn-crafted items including star wands, keychains, flower hair clips, arm cuffs, coasters, and hand warmers. Forever Flowers blends the beauty of bouquets with everlasting love from crocheting, which makes it the perfect gift for yourself or others to commemorate a moment with. Forever Flowers offers a wide range of crocheted products from flowers, coasters, plants and more that can be used for many different purposes. Yellowbunny Crochets sells handmade crochet items, mostly plushies like animals and many different types of keychains. They usually sell a variety of crochet animals, from whales to bees to kirby to animated vegetables! Meghna's Nails sells handmade press-on nails. Each set is carefully painted with gel polish, beads, and gems. We bring affordable and convenient nails that are available in a variety of designs, shapes, and sizes straight to you! Great for elevating any outfit, Meghna's nails brings beauty in details! Earthwise Pens We are a business who believes in being as environmentally friendly as possible, without making the product expensive. Our products have the same level of quality as other products, and the same price, but eco-friendly. Learn about the ARTrepreneur program and how teens bring their small business dreams to life. Celebrating 10 years of SJPL TeenHQ

events.title: Crafternoon for Adults, Tweens and Teens

cases.refreshed: Come unwind and learn something new at our monthly crafternoon! No experience is necessary. Supplies will be provided, and you're welcome to bring any of your own. In fact, some of these crafts may benefit from your personal stash! The activities will be suitable for ages 10 and up. We will have project samples each day to help you visualize the end result. Programs will be on the fourth Sunday of the month. • October – Cardboard Nicho. Recommended items to bring: small images of a cherished item, symbol, memory, or a loved one you miss. • November – Embossing Aluminum Food Charms. Recommended items to bring: colorful Sharpies. • December – Felt and Beaded Patches. Recommended items to bring: old jewelry you don't mind disassembling, beads, colorful thread, loose buttons, scraps of fabric and lace. ¡Ven a relajarte y a aprender algo nuevo en nuestra tarde mensual de artesanías! No se necesita experiencia. Se proporcionarán los materiales, pero puedes traer los que quieras. De hecho, ¡algunas de estas artesanías pueden beneficiarse de tus propios materiales! Las actividades serán aptas para mayores de 10 años. Cada día tendremos ejemplos de proyectos para ayudarte a visualizar el resultado final. • Agosto – Paisaje de playa en collage • Septiembre – Pintura de hongos • Octubre – Nicho de cartón. Materiales recomendados para traer: imágenes pequeñas de un objeto preciado, un símbolo, un recuerdo o un ser querido al que extrañas. • Noviembre – Dijes de aluminio con relieve. Artículos recomendados para traer: marcadores Sharpie de colores, piensa en cuál es tu comida reconfortante. • Diciembre – Parches de fieltro y cuentas. Artículos recomendados para traer: joyas viejas que no te importe desarmar, cuentas, hilo de colores, botones sueltos, retazos de tela y encaje.

cases.refreshed: This program was brought to you by the San Jose Legacy Youth Foundation. Part of the STEM Sundays Programming at Alviso Branch Library. The Julia Robinson Math Festival is an event that provides students with fun and meaningful math experiences to develop their mathematical confidence, joy, and problem-solving skills. At the festival, there will be a variety of play-based, manipulative-based math puzzles and games for students in grades K - 8 and their parents/caregiver. Each activity will be led by at least one trained volunteer who will introduce the activity and keep students engaged and excited as they explore. The festival will be open for 1 hour, during which time kids will get to explore the festival at their own pace, choosing where they want to go and for how long they want to do each activity. Recommended for ages 5 - 10+. Free. No registration required.

cases.refreshed: Step into the world of 3D modeling with this fun, hands-on workshop designed for kids and teens! Participants will learn the basics of 3D design using free, beginner-friendly software like Tinker CAD or SketchUp. Students will follow step-by-step guidance to create and personalize their own 3D keychain model using custom text, shapes, and patterns. Each participant will work on their own device with live instructor support throughout. There will be a live demonstration of the 3D printer working. Participants may receive a 3D printed giveaway upon participation. If we run out of time, participants are welcome to come join our Maker Lab on the first Wednesday of each month from 3-5 PM to have their designs printed. Free. For ages 9 and up. Basic computer familiarity required (no prior 3D design experience needed). Please make sure to create an account on Tinkercad before class starts if you don't already have one. Parents need to stay with their children if the children do not have/know their username and password for Tinkercad. Computers and space are limited. You are welcome to bring your own laptop. Registration required: Please only register if you plan to attend. If you are unable to attend, please be sure to cancel your registration at least 24 hours in advance, giving staff time to contact people on the waitlist.

cases.refreshed: Stuck with a technology question? Need help with an ongoing issue or learning something new? Stop by the Rinconada branch library for our drop-in tech help Tuesday mornings. Staff is available to help with a variety of tech questions including: Learning to use Libby and/or Hoopla; Accessing library databases and services; Downloading and streaming content; Navigating the City of Palo Alto Library website; Downloading and using the new PACL app; Wi-Fi connection; Printing; Creating an email account; Basic computer skills; Installing and using common apps; And more… Unfortunately, helping you fix damaged hardware or software is not within our scope. Help is given on a first-come, first-served basis. Please bring any devices you use, make sure they are charged, and have your necessary passwords. We look forward to helping you.

Cash and most payment apps accepted. No obligation to purchase. The Fair will be held during the TeenHQ Theater Production. Fuzzy and Fluffy is among the scheduled vendors and will sell popular crocheted items, including loaf cats, octopi, and chickens. Its keychains include mini octopuses, mushroom pops, and mini chickens. These items are perfect as birthday or holiday gifts, or even room decor! We're looking forward to meeting you at our market! Welcome to Green Apple Boutique! We are a small business located in the Bay Area and would love to have you as a part of our community! Our shop is currently focusing on the production of pins and jewelry but we plan to expand our inventory to cute stationery in the future! Lils Creations features handmade jewelry, customized stationery, beadable pens, unique keychains and charms. Designed with care, high-quality materials, and a touch of character-inspired charm, my items are crafted to offer thoughtful, one-of-a-kind gifts and accessories. Calderon & Co's business is the amalgamation of a love for toys, 3D printing, and making money. The goal was to create a toy that could satisfy the urge to fidget or imagine new, forbearing the spontaneous horrors of a bored mind, without being a traditional, hyper-consumeristic toy that serves little purpose beyond draining your wallet. Three main problems were identified, alongside a single solution: affordable toys suck, they don't keep people still, and the CEO of C&C is very broke. The solution? A selection of 3D-printed fidget toys, tested profusely. What makes this selection unique is that people of all ages can come to the table and try the fidgets firsthand. Every effort is made to ensure product quality through careful selection of what gets sold, and by personally breaking them in so the initial rough texture is ameliorated as much as possible. Aydraw Art's crafts and creations take the ease- and add some style. We create practical trinkets such as beautiful handmade keychains, pipe cleaner flowers, cards, cups, jewelry bowls, and so much more all to inspire your creative flame! For reasonable prices add some bling and express your individuality and creativity today! Two Tiny Potatoes sells yarn-crafted items including star wands, keychains, flower hair clips, arm cuffs, coasters, and hand warmers. Forever Flowers blends the beauty of bouquets with everlasting love from crocheting, which makes it the perfect gift for yourself or others to commemorate a moment with. Forever Flowers offers a wide range of crocheted products from flowers, coasters, plants and more that can be used for many different purposes. Yellowbunny Crochets sells handmade crochet items, mostly plushies like animals and many different types of keychains. They usually sell a variety of crochet animals, from whales to bees to kirby to animated vegetables! Meghna's Nails sells handmade press-on nails. Each set is carefully painted with gel polish, beads, and gems. We bring affordable and convenient nails that are available in a variety of designs, shapes, and sizes straight to you! Great for elevating any outfit, Meghna's nails brings beauty in details! Learn about the ARTrepreneur program and how teens bring their small business dreams to life. Celebrating 10 years of SJPL TeenHQ
